overview: Develvyn — The Family Suite is a privacy-first apartment and family management PWA by Develvyn Technologies Pvt Ltd. It supports Apartment, Family, Watchman, and Founder Portal modes with Internet Identity biometric login, invite-based onboarding, DPDP-compliant consent flows, financial audit trails, and a real-time support ticket system.
features: Internet Identity biometric login with auto-routing by role
Apartment Mode: maintenance tracking, visitor log, notice board, issue management, wallet with 2-admin approval
Family Mode: tasks, calendar, grocery list, expenses — completely private
Watchman Mode: icon-based duty screen, gate status toggles, 3-tap visitor log, shift handover
Founder Portal: health strip, subscription table, support tickets, team management
DPDP-compliant consent flows with active checkbox and right to withdraw
D-prefix invite code system (DAPT/DFAM/DWCH/DFND) with QR card fallback for watchman
Permanent financial audit trails with correction-entry-only policy
